title: Nice scale with removable bowl
text: Nice scale with removable bowl. Kitchen scales can be a nightmare, this has a handly removable bowl that also is good in the dishwasher. It makes measuring so much easier then a typical kitchen scale.

product_metadata.title: Fradel Digital Kitchen Food Scale with Bowl (Removable) and Measuring Cup - Stainless Steel, Backlight, 11lbs Capacity - Cooking, Baking, Gym, Diet - Precise Measuring (Black)
features: High-Precise Measurement: Accurately measure both wet and dry ingredients with the Fradel digital food scale with bowl equipped with a portable handle, which features high accuracy, convenient functions, and fast response. Display shows 0.1oz/1g increments when weighing ingredients

Easy Unit Conversion: This digital scale converts units between oz/lb'oz/fl'oz/g/mL at the touch of a button, making it the perfect kitchen scale. This compact scale also has a back-lit LCD display that lights up when it powers on, and is perfect for recipes by unit or by weight.

Multi-Function: Able to measure/weigh the volume of milk, water, oil, flour, powder, or any other solid food in a large removable stainless steel mixing bowl. A portable handle is attached for carrying the scale easily around the kitchen.
Tare Function: The Fradel Scale comes with a great tare function that allows you to subtract the weight of container, and measure ingredients accurately.
User Friendly: The handle of the base has a backlit LCD screen with zero/tare functionality to easily measure multiple different foods sequentially. Requires 2 AAA batteries (not included).
